fields.name: image
fields.label: Car image
fields.description: The left half (a banner above the form on phones).

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Car image alt text
fields.description: Describes the image for screen readers.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: E.g. RESERVE NOW.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Under the heading.

fields.name: submitLabel
fields.label: Button text
fields.description: E.g. PROCEED.

fields.name: submitAction
fields.label: Send the form to (URL)
fields.description: Where the data is posted as JSON; empty: only the success message.

fields.name: successMessage
fields.label: Confirmation message
fields.description: Replaces the form once sent.

fields.name: disclaimer
fields.label: Privacy disclaimer
fields.description: Small print under the button; the email and privacy link follow it.

fields.name: privacyEmail
fields.label: Privacy contact email
fields.description: E.g. mailto:privacy@jswmotors.com.

fields.name: privacyEmailText
fields.label: Privacy contact email text
fields.description: E.g. privacy@jswmotors.com.

fields.name: privacyLink
fields.label: Privacy notice link
fields.description: The privacy notice page.

fields.name: privacyLinkText
fields.label: Privacy notice link text
fields.description: E.g. Full Privacy Notice.

fields.name: amountLabel
fields.label: Amount label
fields.description: On the price card, e.g. RESERVATION AMOUNT.

fields.name: amount
fields.label: Reservation amount (₹)
fields.description: In rupees, e.g. 10000; empty hides the card. Match the payment service.

fields.name: amountBadge
fields.label: Amount badge
fields.description: Optional tag beside the label, e.g. REFUNDABLE.

fields.name: amountNote
fields.label: Amount note
fields.description: Under the amount, e.g. Total payable today.

fields.name: razorpayKeyId
fields.label: Razorpay Key ID
fields.description: Public Key ID only (rzp_test_… / rzp_live_…), never the Key Secret. Empty: no payment.

validation.customErrorMsg: Enter the Key ID (rzp_test_… or rzp_live_…), never the Key Secret: this page is public.

fields.name: paymentService
fields.label: Payment service URL
fields.description: The service that creates and verifies payments; empty: test mode.

fields.name: merchantName
fields.label: Name in the payment window
fields.description: E.g. JSW Motors; shown in the checkout.

fields.name: successPage
fields.label: Page after a successful payment
fields.description: After a payment (default: /confirmation).

fields.name: failurePage
fields.label: Page after a failed payment
fields.description: After a failed payment (default: /payment-failed).

fields.name: title
fields.label: Section name
fields.description: E.g. User Details; names the fields after it (screen readers).

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.description: Shown in the field, e.g. First Name; its kind follows the name.

fields.name: fieldName
fields.label: Field name
fields.description: The value's key in the sent data, e.g. firstName; empty: from the label.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.description: Shown until a choice is made, e.g. Select City.

fields.name: fieldName
fields.label: Field name
fields.description: The choice's key in the sent data, e.g. city; empty: from the label.

fields.name: options
fields.label: Cities
fields.description: The choices, one city per entry.
